questions: Do you have involuntary shaking or trembling in either hand?
Does the shaking occur when your hands are held out or when you use them?
Does it also occur when your hands are completely relaxed?
Does the shaking vary substantially from moment to moment?
Can the shaking stop when you concentrate on another task?
Does it lessen when you hold or move the other hand in a different rhythm?
Is one hand affected much more than the other?
Do you have slowness, stiffness, or reduced movement?
Do you have difficulty with balance or walking?
Have you noticed weakness, numbness, abnormal sensation, or loss of coordination?
Does anyone in your family have a similar tremor?
Do caffeine, anxiety, or lack of sleep make it worse?
Does drinking alcohol temporarily reduce it?
Did the symptoms begin after an injury, illness, major stress, or medication change?
